title: One request path on the stream role, whether Postgres answers or not
description: The stream role has two request paths written as twins: the online handlers and segmentOffline, streamOffline, subtitleOffline and attachmentOffline, kept in step by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: The four Offline handlers are gone: each stream route resolves the session and film from Postgres or, while it is away, from the snapshot, then runs one handler
A test runs every stream route's request table with Postgres up and with it away and asserts the same status and body where the snapshot can answer
